# Vector Utility
A clinical utility-grid language for compact mastering controls. Dark ink surfaces, restrained raised panels, and one teal signal accent establish hierarchy without a hero. Typography separates brand, section labels, control labels, and numeric readouts with Inter for interface text and JetBrains Mono for values.
